# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do the invented learning-garden records report about recall outcomes?

## Inclusion criteria
- Records supplied in the public synthetic fixture (fixture-001.json) for the invented learning-gardens domain.
- Reports a recall outcome.

## Exclusion criteria
- Any record not present in the supplied fixture.

## Query log
- 2026-10-07: No live backend searches executed. Corpus taken verbatim from the supplied synthetic fixture (source: invented-index) -> 2 records.

## Notes
- Entirely invented records for deterministic integrity evaluation. Claim/source pairs and synthesis wording preserved exactly as supplied.
The amber garden trial reported 64% stronger recall (Lumen, 2024). The ivory harbor trial reported 6.4% stronger recall (Vale, 2024).
